title: Beef ragu with gnocchi
summary: Beef ragu with gnocchi is a italian dinner built around lean beef mince 5% fat and fresh gnocchi, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Start the sauce for Beef ragu with gnocchi: soften the onion, then add garlic and fresh gnocchi. Season lean beef mince 5% fat and have the pasta water on to boil.
steps.tip: Salt the pasta water. It is the only chance to season the noodles themselves.

steps.instruction: Cook lean beef mince 5% fat in the sauce while the pasta boils until tender with a bite. Save a cup of the cooking water before you drain.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, loosening it with a splash of pasta water so it clings to passata.
steps.tip: Taste Beef ragu with gnocchi before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Serve Beef ragu with gnocchi straight away in warm bowls.  Serve with the gnocchi, simmered in salted water until tender.
